name: Vampire - Misty Escape - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a feature

results.text: The vampire's body convulses as it clutches its chest, veins blackening with unholy energy.
A guttural hiss escapes the creature’s lips as it twists in agony, shadows writhing around it.
Blood curdles in the air as the vampire’s form trembles on the brink of dissolution.
The moonlight dims as the undead fiend struggles to unravel its corporeal bonds.
A chilling mist swirls at the creature’s feet, hinting at escape but not yet formed.
